sourceDate.text: 丞相北平侯張蒼卒 (151 BCE)

work.en: eighteen treatises on yin-yang, law, and the calendar

claims.action: followed campaign through Wu Pass to Xianyang

claims.assessment: authority on Han law and calendar
resolute and upright but lacking strategic learning

claims.statement: tall, heavyset, pale and smooth as a gourd
over eight chi tall; toothless in old age, lived on milk

translationRepairs: Chang declined illness and did not attend court audience; after three years he died, posthumous title marquis Dao.
Chang pleaded illness and did not attend court audience; after three years he died, posthumous title marquis Dao.
s0078 謝病不朝見 means Chang excused himself from court on grounds of illness; 'declined illness' misreads 謝病. The proposed 'pleaded illness' is accurate, grammatical, and matches the Chinese.
